title: Variables
summary: Variables store values so you can reuse them later. They act as containers for information, such as numbers, text, or other data types.
sample_question: What is a variable and why is it useful?

title: Loops
summary: Loops let you repeat an action multiple times without writing the same code repeatedly. The two common kinds are for loops and while loops.
sample_question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop.
